shared_requirements.requirement: Server derives actor identity; enforce resource/action permissions and database grants/policies. Validated writes atomically update domain state, append an event and store a command receipt. Keys are scoped to actor/resource; repeated keys return the original result, changed payloads conflict, and semantic duplicates do not create duplicate effective actions.

Events include event_id, schema_version, aggregate_id/version, actor_id, source, occurred_at, recorded_at, correlation_id and idempotency_key. Protect sensitive payloads; keep audit access separate. Corrections preserve the prior action while retained.
Store instants in UTC plus the participant time zone and applicable local_date. Distinguish reported occurrence time from server acknowledgement; validate backdating and ambiguous dates.

Nancy supports user-initiated two-way voice with real microphone input and spoken responses in S01. Voice and touch invoke the same authenticated typed commands. Use GPT Sol with high reasoning behind the speech layer. Client, family/friend and administrator interactions are principally voice; every role has a complete UI path as its features ship. Subscription-backed text reasoning and an MCP tunnel do not supply speech entitlement or prove an audio conversation. Qualify the speech provider/device path independently; the chosen GPT-6 Sol high remains the reasoning backend. One tap opens a continuous voice session; explicit End closes immediately. Initial tunable defaults: 0.9 seconds of end-of-turn silence, 30 seconds idle plus a visible/audible 10-second closure grace; never count idle while Nancy is speaking or thinking. Support user interruption of speech only after device echo/false-trigger checks. Foreground Hey Nancy requires opt-in, visible listening state, bounded audio handling and a qualified actual-device path; no automatic background phone wake is implied.

Maintain simple queryable projections from transactional records/events. IDs, plan/protocol versions and consent-scoped queries support later reports without a dashboard or a separate analytics platform.

From S01 local database commits survive refresh/process restart, uncertain writes are reconciled by receipt, and disconnected actions never claim success. Verify encrypted backup export/restore before retaining meaningful data. S03 adds durable pending device commands, interruption recovery and revocation-safe cache handling.

Automated synthetic regression and live acceptance run together. Test denial and duplicate/correction cases; log sanitized evidence IDs, revision, environment, time and observer. Keep destructive tests off active care records. Live means the actual deployed local database/auth path, real configured GPT/speech services and intended device; cloud database hosting is not required and disposable PGlite tests alone are insufficient.

Draft/proposed day and meal plans are separate from accepted immutable versions from S01. Explicit acceptance binds the exact reviewed version and current observations; later edits create revisions. Actual task/meal reports introduced in S02 remain factual history when a plan changes.

External completion intent and local transition commit together. Workers lease jobs, retry within bounds, reconcile unknown outcomes and expose pending/failed state. Do not promise exactly one network request.

Keep service charges under the confirmed budget; track ChatGPT-plan allowance separately from metered GPT reasoning/speech. Qualify the existing subscription first. Quota/auth failures are visible and recoverable; no silent switch to API billing, different model, top-up or paid upgrade, and no deletion of required care history. Non-GPT speech costs stay inside the service ceiling.

Treat model output as untrusted proposed intent. Validate exact task/meal identities, allowed fields, consent and expected versions; reject unknown targets and clinical rule changes. A fluent reply or proposed completion never proves a saved plan or performed activity. Family/administrator task requests remain pending until the addressed client approves; schedule availability is not inferred capacity. Rejection with a reason atomically creates linked family help and an administrator flag.

Voice intent and buttons share a typed, role-authorized destination registry. Reject unknown or unauthorized targets; clearly explain features not yet available. Navigation alone cannot mutate a plan or report activity. Preserve My Day as the client home; avoid adding setup/clinical complexity to it. Session-start priority is computed from current authorized local calendar entries, scheduled task/meal windows, actual reports and unresolved work; each suggestion cites the relevant record/time and asks before changing a schedule.

Tasks expose what, urgency (high/medium/low) and scheduled date/time. Meals are tasks with linked meal details, not a second competing task ledger. Persist stable occurrence IDs and date/time context from the accepted plan; S02 adds actual reports. Planning/acceptance does not mark an item completed or eaten. Capture proposed duration or unknown in planning and preserve it with the plan. In S02 maintain actual performed/eaten/deferred times separately, and in S04 explicitly review missed prior-day occurrences.

human_action_policy.source: Each slice's human_actions array is authoritative; docs/HUMAN_ACTIONS.md is its generated reading view.
human_action_policy.agent_responsibility: Build, configure, debug, migrate, test and prepare concrete reviewable outputs within existing authorization. Do not turn routine technical work into human chores.
human_action_policy.carry_forward: Reuse existing access, consent, decisions and valid evidence. Never request the same authorization again merely because another slice needs it.
human_action_policy.timing: Ask only when the action is needed; continue independent authorized work while waiting. A list entry is a future requirement, not an immediate request.
human_action_policy.conditional_actions: Apply a conditional item only when its condition is true. Record not_applicable with a specific reason when false; an agent may establish this from evidence without asking the user. Reassess the status when the trigger changes.
human_action_policy.completion: A slice cannot be done while an applicable slice_completion human action is unfinished. Paid-commitment, daily-reliance, clinical-use and release-gate items block only that named operation/gate, not unrelated free or supervised feature work.
human_action_policy.evidence: Done requires an actual completion reference and timestamp; record private or sanitized references, not names, credentials, clinical records or invented signoffs.
human_action_policy.roles: Human-action owner labels describe responsibilities, not application permissions. The application has exactly four roles: administrator, client, family/friend and clinician. One person may hold several responsibilities; the project owner is confirmed as both administrator and technical lead. Keep account identities private.
human_action_policy.deferred: Microsoft 365 Outlook calendar and Asana access are deferred until available; email delivery is also deferred. Their authorization is not a prerequisite for the October 6 local client trial.

delivery_focus.outcome: The client taps Talk to Nancy and chooses what to do in a time-aware voice conversation; My Day and other direct UI paths expose the same tasks, plans and actuals. Across S01-S04 the client plans meals/tasks, reports activity, recovers from interruptions and returns to reviewed carryover.
delivery_focus.scope_boundary: One master Talk to Nancy button is the primary client experience, available from home/My Day and all shipped client views. It opens one general conversation with only "Hi <preferred name>, what can I help with?", then listens. Show Starting/Preparing until audio begins, Speaking during playback and Listening only when taking the client's turn. Contextual suggestions follow the client's request, using current local time and authorized outstanding records; do not append an unsolicited agenda to the greeting. No workflow picker, task screen, meal screen or planning command is required first. The client can redirect at any time. Voice workflows execute the same typed commands without requiring navigation; visual views are optional support and remain directly accessible with independent buttons. The morning routine window is 08:00 inclusive to 11:00 exclusive in the participant profile time zone, covering breakfast, planning the day, post-breakfast exercise and rehab. These are flexible planned activities, not fixed appointment times or automatic completion. Suggest only relevant pending items, prioritize imminent appointments, and use known meal/activity reports; if breakfast or completion state is unknown, ask. Post-breakfast exercise follows confirmed breakfast in suggestions. Use only supplied approved exercise/rehab tasks; guided protocol execution remains S07/S08. Outside this window the same master button works and Nancy adapts to the current day. The prior 10:00 routine is a preference, never an access restriction. S04 adds opted-in scheduled prompts with a durable scheduler. Opening Talk to Nancy starts the short personalized greeting; contextual suggestions follow the client's response. This is not permission for automatic background microphone activation or a scheduled prompt.

reuse_plan.verification: Source and test inspection only; no extracted code or Cerberus test result counts as Companion implementation/live evidence. Record provenance and freshly test any extracted or ported code.
reuse_plan.architecture: Retain React/TypeScript/Vite, Node/Fastify, local PostgreSQL/auth and the independent care service. Adapt only small Cerberus subscription/MCP patterns; no runtime data, credentials or general orchestration import. Each component pins its own source revision; the top-level revision is the original assessment baseline.

Private LifeCore store, production credentials and personal data
Offline-only launcher and Render paid-hosting manifest
Browser dictation as proof of two-way Nancy voice
Planned M53 morning preparation as an implemented scheduler

product_contract.navigation_policy: One master Talk to Nancy button is the primary client experience, available from home/My Day and all shipped client views. It opens one general conversation with only "Hi <preferred name>, what can I help with?", then listens. Show Starting/Preparing until audio begins, Speaking during playback and Listening only when taking the client's turn. Contextual suggestions follow the client's request, using current local time and authorized outstanding records; do not append an unsolicited agenda to the greeting. No workflow picker, task screen, meal screen or planning command is required first. The client can redirect at any time. Voice workflows execute the same typed commands without requiring navigation; visual views are optional support and remain directly accessible with independent buttons. Voice and buttons share a typed, role-authorized destination registry. My Day exposes the same saved tasks. Reject unknown or unauthorized destinations; navigation alone never accepts a plan or reports activity. Keep the active conversation/context available when changing views unless the client ends it or a genuine lifecycle condition closes it.

task_model.schedule_policy: Persist the scheduled instant with participant time zone/local date; display the date/time in that zone. An unknown time is explicitly unscheduled until supplied, never invented. S02 rescheduling preserves old/new values, actor, versions and an event. Capture a proposed duration (or explicit unknown) and ask whether an appointment or task should occupy a proposed local calendar slot; only an explicitly accepted version changes the schedule. At session start rank impending appointments, meals, overdue tasks and commitments from current facts. This is assistance, not an autonomous calendar mutation. The morning routine window is 08:00 inclusive to 11:00 exclusive in the participant profile time zone, covering breakfast, planning the day, post-breakfast exercise and rehab. These are flexible planned activities, not fixed appointment times or automatic completion. Suggest only relevant pending items, prioritize imminent appointments, and use known meal/activity reports; if breakfast or completion state is unknown, ask. Post-breakfast exercise follows confirmed breakfast in suggestions. Use only supplied approved exercise/rehab tasks; guided protocol execution remains S07/S08. Outside this window the same master button works and Nancy adapts to the current day. The prior 10:00 routine is a preference, never an access restriction.
task_model.meal_policy: A planned meal has one task occurrence identity and meal-specific details. Task list and meal view project the same record; accepting a meal plan does not mean eaten, and one meal report must not double count completion. Offer multiple household-appropriate choices and a collaborative alternative/healthier modification path; discuss portions within approved preferences and avoid unsupported clinical dietary prescriptions. Confirm missing ingredients before adding them to a minimal grocery list.
task_model.internal_metadata: Stable IDs, kind, participant, versions, source and audit fields remain internal; keep the client-facing form simple.

product_contract.family_notification_policy: Per-recipient opt-in and client-scoped sharing grants, including meal tasks. Notify only committed activity or schedule changes; recheck grants at delivery, suppress effective duplicates and honor revocation. No notification is sent merely because Nancy suggested a plan. Task-request inbox items, rejection-derived help and administrator flags follow family_task_requests.delivery_policy; they are distinct from optional completion/reschedule alerts.
product_contract.clinical_dashboard_policy: S12 supplies archetype-specific configurations and authorized data exports. Prepare reviewable metric/export definitions with clinical partners before enabling them; do not infer treatment targets or diagnoses. Achievement UI design remains later in S09.

data_hosting.migration_policy: Versioned schema migrations and encrypted, tested export/restore preserve IDs, grants, plans, reports, events and receipts. Durable state stays in the care service; do not couple identity/domain commands to one hosting vendor.
data_hosting.cloud_processing: GPT inference remains remote; speech processing location depends on the independently qualified local or hosted speech path. Document actual remote processing before retaining care data; local durable storage does not make all processing local.

Keep the model warm and synthesize coherent phrases/sentences as Sol text becomes available; Kokoro returns each full waveform, so Pocket native-chunk timing is not Heart performance evidence. Integrate local speech input, Heart playback/cancellation, GPT-6 Sol high and authorized care commands. Actual iPhone/Safari conversation timing, interruptions, privacy and foreground wake consent still require qualification. Never silently change voice, model or billing. See docs/architecture/VOICE_MODEL_DECISION_2026-10-05.md#final-owner-decision-heart. Navigation estimates improved; general Sol-high response delay remains variable. Evidence: docs/evidence/S01-LATENCY-IMPLEMENTATION-2026-10-05.json.

family_task_requests.submission_policy: Use an explicit client-scoped request_tasks grant. Confirm intended client, task, requested local date/time and priority by voice or form; clarify missing or ambiguous values instead of inventing a deadline. Capture estimated duration, travel or assistance needs when needed for feasibility. A confirmed submission creates a pending request and in-app client inbox item, not an assigned or accepted task. Priority is the requester suggestion, not authority over the client.
family_task_requests.capacity_policy: Before submission and again at acceptance, evaluate authorized local appointments, accepted tasks/meals, expected effort/duration/travel, rest preferences, client-reported capacity and supplied approved limitations. Free calendar time alone does not establish capacity. If duration/capacity is unknown or constraints conflict, ask the client and offer another time, less work or help. Never infer clinical capacity or override an approved limitation. Use a bounded availability summary for requesters without exposing unshared appointment/clinical details. Client acceptance is necessary; it does not waive known constraints.
family_task_requests.approval_policy: Only the addressed client can accept the exact pending request revision and reviewed date/time/priority. Family, administrators and model tools cannot impersonate client approval. Silence, closing the conversation, an expired session and a suggested alternative never imply acceptance. A changed time/task/priority requires a fresh client review. Atomically link an accepted request to exactly one task occurrence and applicable accepted plan/schedule version through the care service, preserving unrelated choices; acceptance is not completion.
family_task_requests.rejection_policy: Ask gently for a short client-provided reason and confirm it before final rejection; a simple reason such as I cannot take this on today is sufficient, with no clinical explanation required. If the client pauses before supplying a reason, leave the request unaccepted and do not repeatedly pressure them. Atomically commit rejection, reason, one linked HelpRequest offered to other authorized family members and one scoped AdministratorFlag. Remove the request from the pending client inbox without assigning a task. Preserve the original request and reason history. No noncompliance label, achievement penalty or automatic reassignment to the client. An alternative helper must explicitly volunteer/accept; acknowledgement and resolution have visible states.
family_task_requests.voice_policy: Talk to Nancy is available from Support Team and minimal administrator views with matching UI paths. Sessions derive actor, active role and selected client from authorization, use bounded context and role-specific server tools, and preserve conversation across permitted views. Role changes must reauthorize and clear incompatible context. Requesters can discuss feasibility, draft and submit requests; only the client session can approve/reject. Opted-in foreground Hey Nancy uses the same role boundary when implemented and qualified; no locked-phone/background wake claim.
family_task_requests.ui_policy: Support Team exposes Request a task, sent requests and Help needed; forms use name, priority, date/time and optional effort/notes with visible requester/status. My Day exposes a small Requests area with Accept and Cannot do this plus reason entry, always available through Nancy and buttons. Minimal administrator setup includes a Requests/help review list and rejection flags; no full operations or achievement dashboard dependency for the request increment. Show requested versus accepted time separately and distinguish planned, accepted and performed states.
family_task_requests.delivery_policy: Initial delivery is durable in-app: client requests, authorized family help inbox items and administrator review flags. A declined task creates these records regardless of optional completion/reschedule alert preferences; external messages and push delivery remain separately opted in, authorized and unimplemented until their connectors exist. Recheck grants on every read and delivery, including requester revocation before acceptance. No suitable family recipient leaves help visibly unassigned for the administrator; do not pretend a helper was notified. Share reason/task details only within explicit grants, with generic external previews. Microsoft 365, Asana and full dashboards are not prerequisites for the request increment.
family_task_requests.consistency_policy: Persist requester/actor/client IDs, request revision, requested/proposed/accepted instants with time zone, priority, capacity-review provenance, decision/reason, linked task/help/flag IDs, events and receipts. Server validates role, scope, exact IDs, current request/day versions and current constraints. Accept/reject races and retries have one durable outcome; a reused key with changed content conflicts. Rejection/help/flag creation is one transaction; a lost response reconciles by receipt. Withdrawn, already decided or stale requests cannot create tasks. External actuation stays held until separately authorized integration exists.
